assessment: A-level tool-first page for "core web vitals test" (480/mo, KD 43): the Core Web Vitals Test is the first screen, the 53-word answer resolves the query directly, and the body answers "lighthouse test" with first-hand AEOeye measurements before handing off to the free SEO audit.

topic.readerProblem: Someone searching "core web vitals test" wants to run the check immediately and know what the result means for their site.
topic.connection: The free SEO audit runs this check site-wide (crawlability, on-page, speed, schema, HTTPS); this page is the single-URL version and links into it.

sources.supports: Core Web Vitals thresholds: LCP 2.5 s, INP 200 ms, CLS 0.1 at the 75th percentile.
Good Core Web Vitals align with what Google core ranking systems seek to reward.
PSI field data covers the trailing 28 days; lab data comes from Lighthouse.
Chrome UX Report is the real-user dataset behind field Core Web Vitals.
AEOeye PSI sample: 3 of 28 SaaS homepages pass all three CWV; 6 had good field LCP with lab score under 50.
